描述_EN: a nobleman would have worn it suspended from a girdle. in 4th-century bc china fashionable for noblemenwore jade pendants. this is one of a pair of dragon-shaped pendants that would have been strung together with other beads, tubes, plaques and rings to form a pendant set.
描述_ZN: 一个贵族会把它悬挂在腰带上。 在公元前4世纪的中国，贵族们流行佩戴玉坠子。 这是一对龙形吊坠中的一个，可以和其他珠子、管子、牌子和戒指串在一起，形成一个吊坠组。
